rationale: handleParseArgsRequest in src/server.js passes req.body.args -- an attacker-controlled JSON array from the HTTP request body -- directly into minimist() with no sanitization, e.g. ['--__proto__.polluted','yes']. Empirically verified against the real npm-installed minimist@1.2.0 tarball: minimist(['--__proto__.y','Polluted']) leaves ({}).y === 'Polluted' afterward (see docs/EXPERIMENT_LOG.md Experiment 1). Note: an earlier draft of this fixture used minimist@1.2.5 and CVE-2021-44906, but empirical testing showed the real 1.2.5 tarball already neutralizes the standard __proto__ and constructor.prototype payload shapes -- it was not a valid REACHABLE case and was replaced with this genuinely-verified one.

authoritative_evidence.detail: handleParseArgsRequest reads req.body.args and calls minimist(rawArgs) with no filtering.
